amr_setup_amendment.status: Planned for checkpoints 23-25; reference observations remain observations, and target contracts must be extended with the adapters/consumers when implemented.
amr_setup_amendment.required_profile: DC calibrator + DMM field readback + lock-in X/Y with internal excitation + stepper
amr_setup_amendment.preserve_rule: Do not initialize/reset, autorange or overwrite operator-selected sensitivity/reference settings on Run. Explicit configure mode is available; output safing remains a separate setup policy.
amr_setup_amendment.calibration_rule: Source-command and sensor-readback calibrations are independent; measured field does not replace the source-control mapping.
amr_setup_amendment.rotation_scope: Motorized controller required initially; manual confirmation workflow deferred.
amr_setup_amendment.signal_scope: Keep truthful X/Y voltages for the current profile. Resistance and voltage/current modes require separate validated adapters; programmed lock-in excitation does not establish sample current.

amr_fixture_contract.oracle: X = (100 ohm + 2 ohm * cos(angle)^2) * 1e-6 A; Y = 0.1 * X. At 180 degrees X is 102 uV and Y is 10.2 uV.
amr_fixture_contract.observation_note: Existing capture steps to 225 degrees while labeling the final row 180 degrees. This file documents AMR-ANGLE-001, not a scientific result to preserve.

known_defects.behavior: Final capture repeats a motor step already performed by the loop, so actual position and saved angle disagree.
known_defects.resolution: Remove the extra movement, verify position and X/Y at all requested angles, remove the strict xfail, and replace the legacy-observation regression with the scientific golden.

known_defects.behavior: Placeholder convert_field_to_voltage multiplies by 0.1, conflicting with the default 10000 Oe/V calibration. 100 Oe requires 0.01 V, not 10 V.
known_defects.resolution: Repair or retire the placeholder during field-adapter work; enforce field/calibration conversion and replace the strict xfail with passing adapter tests.

standardization_principles: All measurement families adopt one shared execution lifecycle (run_experiment, configure_instruments, capture_data, session, safe_shutdown, request_stop, snapshot).
Run runners return a pandas DataFrame for every family; legacy None returns are eliminated upon migration.
All data columns use plain identifiers without embedded units or special punctuation.
Every saved CSV includes a sorted compact JSON mapping of columns to canonical unit strings (or null for unitless).
Constructors perform zero instrument I/O, output directory creation, or filename reservation.
One hardware writer: GUI callbacks never compete with active runner workers.
Software safing de-energizes and disables outputs but never closes instrument sessions.
Windows- and SMB-aware persistence: CSV published last, no accidental overwrite, recoverable raw data.

transitional_policy.description: During vertical slice migration, unmigrated families retain reference observation tests to guard against accidental regressions until their dedicated slice. Migrated families must strictly satisfy their target contract.
transitional_policy.rule: Never claim an unmigrated family satisfies the target contract before its slice commit.

consumers.hardware_feedback_loop: Calibrator outputs voltage -> Custom Magnet -> Hall Sensor -> DMM reads voltage -> verified within 10% tolerance

preserved_behavior: Class names, import paths, and module re-exports remain available during transition
Numerical scientific results, calibration direction and units, and raw data recovery are strict invariants
One-row metadata, blank separator, data table CSV layout via standard_csv_to_metadata_and_data
Generated plot artifacts (_PV.png, _IV.png, _trace.png, _dPvst.png) remain preserved for analysis/notebook consumers
additive_api: Common keyword-only options for run_experiment: on_update=None, save=True, save_partial=None, options=None
Run reservation and tracking via MeasurementRunner, RunRecord, and run_records
Context manager session(save=False) for atomic hardware ownership and cleanup
Standard metadata fields: measurement_schema, measurement_schema_version, run_id, outcome, partial, save_requested, column_units_json

Common state model (IDLE, STARTING, CONFIGURING, RUNNING, STOPPING, SAFING, ANALYZING, SAVING, COMPLETED, ABORTED, FAILED)
Safety status model (UNKNOWN, NOT_NEEDED, SAFING, SAFE, UNSAFE)
approved_safety_corrections: Constructors perform zero instrument I/O; idn() queries deferred to configuration phase within safety boundary
Constructors stop creating output directories or reserving filenames before a run is active
Incremental writes move from completed-looking CSV to run-owned .partial.csv; filename set only upon final publication
Energizing standalone setters (set_output, set_field, initialize) require an active session; out-of-session calls raise before touching hardware
Safing de-energizes and disables outputs but never calls close() or disconnects instrument sessions
Single-writer concurrency: active run worker is sole writer to hardware; GUI callbacks never compete with it
